category: hosted newsletter and automation sender, bring-your-own-SMTP

free_tier.stated: Free: $0/month, Free forever, 1 team member, 1,000 contacts, 5,000 emails a month, Newsletters and 1 automation, Docs and community help
free_tier.notes: The headline is two quotas in different units: 5,000 emails a month and 1,000 contacts. Emails are counted per send and contacts per stored address. The schema has no emails unit, so the unit is mixed.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an outbound email sender with no stated per-object storage cap

retention.stated: Account and customer data are kept while the account is active; after the account is closed the data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except records the law requires to be kept, such as billing
retention.notes: Logs can be filtered over the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or a custom range; no fixed log retention window is stated.

egress.terms: Contacts are exportable by CSV and readable through GET /contacts/export; send logs are readable through GET /logs. No per-GB egress charge or quota is stated.

interface_detail: REST HTTP API under https://api.mailazy.com/api/v1 using X-API-Key and X-API-Secret headers; dashboard at portal.mailazy.com
tooling: curl or any HTTP client with an API key pair; the dashboard for lists, templates and schedules
chaining: A bring-your-own-SMTP sender: the Free plan holds contacts, newsletters and one automation, while delivery goes through a separate SMTP provider the reader connects and pays directly, so the SMTP provider's own sending limits also apply.

limits.value: 5,000 emails a month on Free; at the limit all sending stops and does not resume until usage resets on the billing day or the plan is upgraded
1,000 contacts on Free; at the limit new contacts are not added
Behavioral email rules and AI writing are on Pro and up; on Free their API paths answer 402 and one automation is allowed

binding_note: The 5,000 emails a month cap stops all sending until the billing-day reset, before the 1,000-contact cap or the Pro-gated features bind for a sender.

identity_cost.detail: The live sign-in at portal.mailazy.com asks only for an email address and continues with a link: 'Enter your email to continue to Mailazy.' No card or phone is asked at that step. Further signup fields are unverified: the account was not created.

reliability_note: Mailazy does not run mail servers; email leaves through the SMTP provider the reader connects. Logs store one row per delivery attempt, retries appear as separate rows, and test sends are not logged.
confidence_note: Free tier, limits, API and sign-in step are stated on first-party pages and quoted; delivery and the post-email signup fields remain unverified.

evidence.quote: Free covers 1,000 contacts and 5,000 emails a month, Pro 25,000 and 100,000.
evidence.proved: Free plan allows 1,000 contacts and 5,000 emails a month

evidence.quote: Your own SMTP provider, such as Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark or Cloudflare. You add its credentials in Settings. You pay that provider directly, at their rates.
evidence.proved: delivery goes through an SMTP provider the reader supplies and pays directly

evidence.quote: Free is for newsletters, with one automation and one team member.
evidence.proved: Free plan allows one automation and one team member

evidence.quote: Emails go through **your own** sending service (SMTP). You pay that provider for delivery, at their rates; the plan sets how many Mailazy sends for you each month.
evidence.proved: the plan meters Mailazy sends while the reader's SMTP provider handles delivery

evidence.quote: Monthly counts (emails, AI credits, AI assistant calls) start again on your **billing day**
evidence.proved: monthly email usage resets on the billing day

evidence.quote: **The monthly email limit stops sending.** Your API calls are still accepted, but once the month's emails are used, every email fails in Logs with `Monthly email limit of your plan reached` until usage resets or an upgrade.
evidence.proved: all sending stops at the monthly email cap and does not resume automatically

evidence.quote: **Don't retry a 402.** It changes only when someone upgrades, or, for monthly limits, when usage resets on the billing day.
evidence.proved: plan-limit and feature errors answer 402 and only clear on upgrade or reset

evidence.quote: **402 means the plan stops it.** Limits belong to the organization's [plan](https://mailazy.com/docs/guide/plans-and-billing).
evidence.proved: API calls beyond the plan limits are refused with 402

evidence.quote: Enter your email to continue to Mailazy.
evidence.proved: the live sign-in asks for an email address only, with no card or phone at that step

evidence.quote: The HTTP API your app uses to talk to Mailazy. Every endpoint lives under `https://api.mailazy.com/api/v1`.
evidence.proved: a REST API is available under a documented base URL

evidence.quote: Mailazy does not run mail servers. It hands your email to one you already pay for — Amazon SES, SendGrid, Postmark, Mailgun, your own relay.
evidence.proved: delivery requires an external SMTP provider

evidence.quote: Filter by contact, by result, or by time (last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or a custom range), or page through.
evidence.proved: logs are readable and filterable by time window

evidence.quote: After you close your account, we delete or anonymize your data within a reasonable period, except records the law makes us keep, such as billing.
evidence.proved: customer data is kept while the account is active and cleared after closure with a billing exception

notes: A hosted send manager with a real free tier of 5,000 emails and 1,000 contacts per month and a REST API. The caveat is structural: the reader must connect and pay a separate SMTP provider for delivery, and the free caps and Pro-gated features bind early.
